decision.explanation: Document d00 and d01 describe Rick Leach (born 1964) as a tennis player and incorrectly list him as a basketball player, while d02 contains a contradictory text claiming he played golf; however, d00 provides specific, consistent details about his tennis career (NCAA titles, All-American status, brother married to Lindsay Davenport). Document d03 explicitly describes a different individual, Richard Max 'Rick' Leach (born 1957), as a former college football player and professional baseball player. The prior claim of cricket is unsupported by the provided text. Since the question asks about 'Richard Leach' without specifying the birth year, both the tennis player (d00/d01) and the football/baseball player (d03) are valid associations found in the documents.
